body: We discussed it and decided that what we can do here depends on wether we can fully rely on ops based recovery to serve as a replacement for synced flush and fast full cluster restarts/node dropping off the cluster and joining back. Ops base recovery should do the job but since it's relatively new, we want to gather feedback on how well it performs. @zuketo has offered to collect to that  🙏

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
With peer recovery retention leases and sequence-number based replica allocation, a regular flush can speed up recovery as a synced-flush. With this change, we will flush instead of synced-flush when a shard becomes inactive.

Depends on #48430
Closes #31965
